strings.metaTitle: Kazi | Know what you bring in. Know what you take home.
strings.metaDescription: Log every service with the right commission and see how much is yours, how much has landed and how much is still coming. Available for Android.
strings.ogDescription: Log every service with the right commission and see how much is yours, how much has landed and how much is still coming.
strings.heroTitle: Know what you bring in. Know what you take home.
strings.heroLede: Log every service with the right commission and see, at any point in the cycle, how much is yours, how much has landed and how much is still coming.
strings.heroNote: Available for Android. The iPhone version is on its way.
strings.ariaHome: Kazi home screen: August cycle earnings, $1,712.00, and today's four services
strings.ariaDetail: A service detail in Kazi: gel extensions, $180 brought in, 45% commission, your earnings $81, with the Mark as paid button
strings.ariaList: Kazi service list filtered by August, with one item swiped aside showing the Paid action
strings.ariaSummary: August summary in Kazi: $4,280 brought in, $1,712 in earnings, and the total by service type
strings.howTitle: Three numbers. No math in your head.
strings.howLede: Every service has a price and a commission. Kazi does the math service by service and keeps what's already landed apart from what's still coming.
strings.howGeneratedDesc: What your clients paid for the services in the period.
strings.howEarningsDesc: Your share: the commission on each service, added up. Every service type can have its own.
strings.howPaidPendingDesc: What's already in your hands and what's still to come this cycle.
strings.howFootnote: Example with 32 services in August and commissions between 30% and 50%.
strings.featuresTitle: Made for the pace of your day.
strings.featuresLede: Logging is the one move you repeat all day. Everything else stays in the menu until you need it.
strings.f1Title: Open the app and your day is already there.
strings.f1Body: The home screen shows what you've earned in the cycle and which services you did today, with each one's price and commission.
strings.f1Tick1: Cycle earnings, with what's landed and what's left
strings.f1Tick3: A new service in one tap, from any tab
strings.f2Body: Pick the service type and the client: price and commission come filled in. When the payment lands, mark it as paid.
strings.f2Tick1: Log, edit and look up every service
strings.f2Tick2: A different commission for each service type
strings.f2Tick3: Mark as paid from the detail or the list
strings.f3Body: Filter by period, client, service type or status. Swipe an item to mark it as paid without opening anything.
strings.f3Tick1: Filters by period, client, type and status
strings.f3Tick2: Your earnings and the amount brought in on every row
strings.f3Tick3: Pending and paid, side by side
strings.f4Title: The whole month, under the same filter.
strings.f4Body: The same list becomes a panel: how much came in, how much is yours and which service types paid off most in the period.
strings.f4Tick1: Brought in, your earnings, paid and pending
strings.f4Tick2: What each service type brought in
strings.f4Tick3: Changes along with the list filters
strings.configTitle: Set it up once. Use it every day.
strings.configLede: Service types, clients, payment cycle, currency and language live in the menu. You touch them when a price changes, not every time you work.
strings.setServiceTypesDesc: Name, price and commission for each service you offer.
strings.setClientsDesc: Add and edit the people you serve. The name is ready when you log a service.
strings.setCycleDesc: Tell Kazi when you get paid and it adds up your earnings inside that period.
strings.setCurrenciesDesc: Pick your default currency and log in others when a service calls for it.
strings.setLanguageDesc: Switch the app's language whenever you like, without losing anything you've logged.
strings.ctaBody: Log what you've already done and watch your earnings show up on the first screen.
strings.ctaOrigin: Kazi means work in Swahili. Because work is universal.
